title: T034 immutable published content projection is reviewable
summary: From main@c39288f, immutable implementation subject 09d99ef adds the named content domain/application/persistence boundaries, selects only the published revision pointer, preserves revision-scoped contributor credits, extracts public-visible text from all 11 canonical blocks and computes deterministic reading time server-side. Tests-first RED, review RED, local regressions, CI #462, Security #463 and browser verification pass. Only T034 is a candidate checkbox; protected merge and main read-back remain authoritative.

claims.text: PublishedArticleRevision and ContentDocument expose defensive immutable snapshots, and persistence selects only article.published_revision_id.
Contributor credit is ordered and scoped to the selected article revision without article-level fallback or private fields.
All 11 ContentDocument v1 blocks have explicit public-visible text semantics; links, routing identifiers, asset identities and generative execution metadata are excluded.
plainText and readingTimeMinutes are derived in the server application projection and included in the public contract and ETag.
CI #462, Security #463, Java quality/unit, Docker migration regression, frontend contract and browser verification passed on implementation subject 09d99ef.
T035-T041, T056, T057+, Web3, deployment and migrations are unchanged; T036 and T039 remain checked from base main.

write_receipt.update_reason: Record attributable T034 acceptance only after exact implementation-head CI, Security and browser proof passed.
